observations: Title screen fully shows Play stages, Free building, Explore examples, Open my project, descriptions, language and Settings.

Projects dialog fully fits. Storage/export warning, saving-applies-valid-blocks notice, snapshot/export controls, empty saved-project message, preservation footer and Close are readable; background 0 parts / 0 connections.
Confirmation fully shows assembly/code replacement warning and snapshot advice with OK, Cancel and close icon. Underlying import content is intentionally covered.
Car and wall visible in workshop; counter 10 parts / 16 connections, Learner code and Run code. Footer states Project opened. Code runs only when you press Run code.
AI tab shows Status Off, AI operator: not connected, disabled-looking Run with AI, and No frame yet. Goal field shows only tail 'only3 ticks once, observe again, then stop.' Full goal is not visible.
Status Off remains; AI operator: connected and enabled-looking Run with AI visible. Camera says No frame yet. This describes UI appearance, not dispatch/process proof.

AI Status Ready, highlighted top play control, Running the goal. Stop is always available message, visible Stop and disabled-looking Run with AI. Camera preview populated. Tooltip overlaps scene/panel boundary without obscuring Stop. No action trace visible in current viewport.

AI Status Stopped and Goal run stopped visible. Stop/Enable and populated camera preview remain visible. Footer states Input stopped - servos hold their last targets; return to edit mode to reset the robot. Tooltip persists; full action trace not visible.
Full sensor image: blue sky, beige floor, central gray wall and blue/gray lower-side robot geometry. Wall visually approximately x148–498, y165–282; central image is unobstructed by robot geometry.

Full sensor image has same broad composition. Wall approximately x145–496, y165–283 with slight edge slope; relative to observation-1, edges appear a few pixels left and lower in places. Image-coordinate change only; no physical inference.
